messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we promised a concrete plan to cut down noisy pages for inference-routes (esp /chat and /embed). Can we assign owners and ETAs for the three workstreams? dedupe rules, threshold tuning, and paging policy cleanup. I sketched a tiny plan below.

sam: I can take dedupe rules. Plan is to add a 30s fuzzy dedupe window and a signature hash to collapse duplicate alerts from batch jobs. ETA: PR by Thu EOD.

dinesh: I'll own threshold tuning for token-queue alerts. Need to run a 48h sampling job to get baseline percentiles, will post numbers by Wed AM. Tentative change: bump warning->page from 95th to 99th for short spikes.

elaine: I will handle paging policy cleanup / quiet-hours exceptions. Can we standardize the policy docs first? I have a template. Aim to roll policy by next Tue.

marta: Thanks. Action items put more explicitly:
- sam: implement fuzzy dedupe + hash, add unit tests, ship PR (Thu EOD)
- dinesh: sampling job + threshold proposal (Wed AM), small rollout (canary 1 region)
- elaine: rewrite paging policy + exception list (Tue)

marta: Also: two followups from postmortem notes — recurring pattern: nightly batch spikes and cache warm-up flaps. We should add a short-term suppression for the first 5m after deploys and a medium-term plan to add prefix KV caching. Thoughts?

sam: suppression makes sense. For the dedupe rule I'll allow dynamic window if deploy tag present in payload (so we avoid suppressing real regressions).

dinesh: Agree on suppression and also propose a temporary rate-limiter on the alert bridge to prevent pager storms during known batch windows. Will include in proposal.

elaine: For paging policy, propose: route batch-window alerts to a dedicated ops channel (no pages) unless elevated severity. That reduces wakeups while still keeping visibility.

marta: Nice. Can owners add links to the PRs/proposals in this thread when created? I'll track this as the postmortem follow-up in the remediation board.

inc-bot: Postmortem summary linked: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-02-inference-pagerstorm (automated)

sam: FYI: quick snippet of the dedupe check I'm prototyping:
```
# pseudo-rule
key = sha256(alert.signature + str(alert.job_id))
if recent_alerts.exists(key, window=30s):
  suppress()
else:
  emit()
```

sam: adding tests now, will open WIP in about 3hrs.

dinesh: Sampling job started (job id j-8472). ETA results Wed 09:00 PST.

elaine: Draft policy here: https://go/redwood/paging-policy-draft. Putting comments on timeline.

marta: Great. Quick coordination question: do we want a short canary for dedupe changes (i.e., apply to non-prod first) or push to prod w/ toggle?

sam: non-prod canary first. I'll add a runtime flag so we can toggle per-cluster.

dinesh: after we adjust thresholds, we should run a 72h verification to ensure no regression in missed critical alerts. I'll own the verification run.

marta: OK — I'll create the board card and assign to each of you with the ETAs. I'll ping this thread when cards are up. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

elaine: :+1:

sam: on it

dinesh: ack
